findings.highlight: He’s not a Servant that should exist
findings.evidenceJa: 既存のサーヴァントじゃなかった
findings.governingReading: he did not appear to be one of the existing Servants
findings.explanation: Rin’s roster observation becomes an ontological prohibition.

findings.evidenceJa: この世の全てを治めた

findings.highlight: heroic spirits are as strong as their fame
findings.evidenceJa: 英霊の強さは召喚された土地での知名度による
findings.governingReading: a Heroic Spirit’s strength depends on fame in the land of summoning
findings.explanation: A causal modifier becomes a crude equation.

findings.evidenceJa: いや、だから反則だって
findings.governingReading: no, that is why I say he is unfair
findings.explanation: Shirou’s tactical conclusion is replaced by a stray affirmation.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーやランサーのように
findings.governingReading: unlike Saber or Lancer, he is not a wielder
findings.explanation: The concrete model for mastery and its character comparison disappear.

findings.highlight: There’s not supposed to be an eighth Servant, so he would be the Joker
findings.evidenceJa: 八人目のサーヴァントって時点で破綻してるのに、そいつ自身がジョーカー
findings.governingReading: the roster already breaks at an eighth Servant, and he himself is also a joker
findings.explanation: Two independent dangers are turned into a causal explanation of one label.

findings.highlight: we’ll have a bed to sleep in here
findings.evidenceJa: ここなら夜になっても暖はとれる
findings.governingReading: we can keep warm here even after night falls
findings.explanation: A practical warmth observation becomes unsupported sleeping accommodation.

findings.governingReading: outwit them with only the two of you
findings.explanation: Lancer mocks their scheming ability, not direct combat victory.

findings.evidenceJa: すぐさま立ち上がって正門に振り向く
findings.governingReading: I immediately stand and turn toward the main gate
findings.explanation: Shirou’s singular action is assigned to both him and Rin.

findings.highlight: It’s great you two are still hanging in there
findings.evidenceJa: お互いしぶとく生き残っているようで何よりだ
findings.governingReading: glad to see we have both stubbornly survived
findings.explanation: Lancer includes himself in a mutual-survival joke; the English addresses only the pair.
The prior wound is relocated from chest to heart.

findings.highlight: Don’t come out with your destructive personality
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の壊し屋っぷりを開き直るな
findings.governingReading: do not defiantly own how much of a destroyer you are
findings.explanation: The comic accusation becomes malformed personality language.

findings.highlight: I can understand Caster not wanting you now
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターが遠坂は要らないもーんって言ってたの、あんまり無視できない
findings.governingReading: we cannot entirely ignore Caster saying she did not need you
findings.explanation: A warning not to dismiss Caster’s criticism becomes Shirou endorsing it.
mirror moon assigns male gender to Lancer’s still-unidentified Master.

findings.highlight: trying to figure out if Lancer knows about them
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二の事を知っているかカマをかけている
findings.governingReading: probing whether Lancer knows about Shinji
findings.explanation: Rin’s precise information-gathering target is broadened to Shinji and Gilgamesh together.
